newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait investment firm set up with $131 mln capital.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait investment firm set up with $131 mln capital.

text.p: A group of Kuwaiti firms and investors have established a Kuwaiti investment company, Bayan Investment Company, with a paid-up capital of 40 million dinars($131.1 million), sources said.
"Today a shareholders meeting approved the establishment of Bayan Investment Company," one said.
Bayan can carry out investment activities locally and internationally, they said added.

The meeting elected Faisal al-Mutawa as chairman of the company which has 29 shareholders including Gulf Bank, al-Ahli Bank, Kuwait Insurance Co, United Realty Co, Faisal Ali al-Mutawa & Sons Co and more than ten individual investors.
Bayan's nominal share price was set at 100 fils. There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.
